# Ringkasan

Pemodelan curah hujan bulanan di Provinsi Riau menggunakan *Random Effects Eigenvector Spatial Filtering* dengan koefisien bervariasi spasial (RE-ESF VC).

- 32 stasiun BMKG × 60 bulan (2015–2019) = 1.920 pengamatan
- Respons: curah hujan bulanan
- Prediktor: altitude, vegetasi (NDVI), jarak ke ekuator, dummy musim hujan, dan 22 komponen PLSR dari luaran CNRM-ESM2 (CMIP6-DCPP)
- Pembobot spasial: invers jarak antarstasiun (`kronecker` terhadap 60 periode), baris distandarkan
- `spmoran::meigen()` + `spmoran::resf()` + `spmoran::resf_vc()`

# Persiapan


```{r packages}
library(readxl)
```

# Import dan Penyusunan Data

```{r import-data}
ch_komplit <- read_excel("data/Data Curah Hujan Komplit.xlsx")
data_enso  <- read_excel("data/Data El Nino La Nina.xlsx")
CNRM_ESM2  <- read_excel("data/CNRM-ESM2 Riau (6x6).xlsx")
CNRM_ESM2  <- CNRM_ESM2[13:372, ]
iden_lokasi <- read_excel("data/Identifikasi Lokasi.xlsx")
latitude   <- read_excel("data/Lokasi Data.xlsx", sheet = "LAT")
longitude  <- read_excel("data/Lokasi Data.xlsx", sheet = "LON")
ndvi       <- read_excel("data/091024 NDVI RIAU Baru (res 500).xlsx", sheet = "NDVI Akhir Bulan")

datakajian1_master <- cbind(CNRM_ESM2[, 2:37], CNRM_ESM2[, 1], ch_komplit, data_enso[, 3])
```

```{r susun-data}
# Periode 2015-2019 (+ 2020 untuk data uji): baris 289 s.d. 360
st <- 289
fn <- 360
datakajian1_master <- datakajian1_master[st:fn, ]
latitude  <- latitude[st:fn, ]
longitude <- longitude[st:fn, ]

latitude  <- melt(latitude,  id = "Waktu")
longitude <- melt(longitude, id = "Waktu")

datakajian1 <- melt(datakajian1_master,
                    id = c(colnames(datakajian1_master[, c(1:36, 37:39, 72)])))
colnames(datakajian1)[c(41, 42)] <- c("Stasiun", "ch")

datakajian1 <- cbind(datakajian1, latitude[, 3], longitude[, 3])
colnames(datakajian1)[c(43, 44)] <- c("lat", "lon")
datakajian1 <- datakajian1 %>% dplyr::arrange(Waktu)
```

```{r dummy-musim}
# Dummy musim hujan: Februari-April dan September-November
ch_komplit <- ch_komplit[st:fn, ]
dfch <- melt(ch_komplit, id = c("Thn", "Bln"))

dfch <- dfch %>%
  mutate(dummy = case_when(
    dfch[, 2] %in% c(2, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11) ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  ))

dummych <- data.frame(Waktu = CNRM_ESM2[st:fn, 1], dfch)
dummych <- dummych %>% dplyr::arrange(Waktu)
```

```{r peubah-lokasi}
rep <- nrow(datakajian1) / 32

altitude <- do.call("rbind", replicate(rep, iden_lokasi[, 13], simplify = FALSE))
ekuator  <- do.call("rbind", replicate(rep, iden_lokasi[, 15], simplify = FALSE))
ekuator2 <- 111.32 * abs(datakajian1[, 43])

ndvi     <- ndvi[, c(1:72, 73)]
ndvi     <- melt(ndvi, id = "Nama")
vegetasi <- ndvi[, 3]

dummy <- dummych[, 6]

datakajian0 <- cbind(datakajian1, altitude, vegetasi, ekuator, ekuator2, dummy)
```

```{r data-latih-uji}
# Data latih (2015-2019) dan data uji
datakajian1 <- datakajian0[1:1920, ]
dftest      <- datakajian0[1921:2304, ]

longlat <- datakajian1[1:32, 43:44]
D <- as.matrix(dist(longlat, method = "euclidean"))

koor  <- datakajian1[1:1920, 43:44]
Y     <- datakajian1[1:1920, 42]
X     <- data.frame(datakajian1[1:1920, c(1:36, 45, 46, 48, 49)])
Xgrid <- X[, 1:36]
```

# Reduksi Dimensi Luaran Model Iklim (PLSR)

```{r plsr}
set.seed(123)
dfpcr <- data.frame(Y, Xgrid)
fit <- plsr(Y ~ ., data = dfpcr, scale = TRUE, validation = "CV")

which.min(MSEP(fit)$val[1, 1, ]) - 1
validationplot(fit, val.type = "MSEP")
```

```{r komponen-plsr}
Xpre <- fit$scores
Xgridbaru <- Xpre[, 1:22]
Xbaru  <- data.frame(X[, 37:40], Xgridbaru)
Xbaru2 <- Xbaru
```

# Matriks Pembobot Spasial

```{r matriks-pembobot}
# Pembobot invers jarak
CS <- 1 / D
CS[!is.finite(CS)] <- 0

matrep <- matrix(rep(1, 60), 60, 60)
CS <- kronecker(matrep, CS)
CS <- CS / rowSums(CS, na.rm = TRUE)

dim(CS)
```

```{r meigen}
meig <- meigen(cmat = CS)
summary(meig$ev)
sum(meig$ev)
sum(meig$ev > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
```

# Autokorelasi Spasial

```{r moran-awal}
wt <- 1
wa <- 1536
SWS <- mat2listw(CS[wt:wa, wt:wa])

# Moran's I pada Y
moran.test(Y[wt:wa], SWS, alternative = "two.sided")

# Moran's I pada galat OLS
datlm  <- data.frame(Y, Xbaru2)
fitols <- lm(Y ~ ., data = datlm)
residual1 <- fitols$residuals[wt:wa]
moran.test(residual1, SWS, alternative = "two.sided")
```

# Model RE-ESF

```{r resf}
meig <- meigen(cmat = CS)
fitesf <- resf(y = Y, x = Xbaru2, meig = meig)
fitesf$e
fitesf
```

```{r diagnostik-resf}
residual4 <- fitesf$resid

# Breusch-Pagan
xreg <- as.matrix(Xbaru2)
e2 <- residual4^2
fitaux <- lm(e2 ~ xreg)
bp.statistic <- length(e2) * summary(fitaux)$r.squared
bp.pvalue <- pchisq(bp.statistic, ncol(xreg), lower.tail = FALSE)
c(statistik = bp.statistic, p_value = bp.pvalue)

# Moran's I residual
SWS <- mat2listw(CS)
moran.test(residual4, SWS, alternative = "two.sided")
```

# Model RE-ESF VC

```{r resf-vc, results="hide"}
fit1 <- resf_vc(y = Y, x = Xbaru2, meig = meig,
                x_sel = FALSE, x_nvc = FALSE, xconst_nvc = FALSE)
```

```{r ringkasan-resf-vc}
fit1$e
fit1
```

```{r rmse-resf-vc}
residual5 <- fit1$resid
nt <- length(residual5)
RMSE <- sqrt(sum(residual5^2) / nt)
cat("Nilai RMSE :", RMSE)
```

```{r diagnostik-resf-vc}
# Breusch-Pagan
xreg <- as.matrix(Xbaru2)
e2 <- residual5^2
fitaux <- lm(e2 ~ xreg)
bp.statistic <- length(e2) * summary(fitaux)$r.squared
bp.pvalue <- pchisq(bp.statistic, ncol(xreg), lower.tail = FALSE)
c(statistik = bp.statistic, p_value = bp.pvalue)

# Moran's I residual
SWS <- mat2listw(CS)
moran.test(residual5, SWS, alternative = "two.sided")
moran.plot(as.vector(residual5), SWS, labels = TRUE, pch = 5)
```

# Peta Koefisien Bervariasi Spasial

```{r grid-riau}
polygons <- read_sf("data/Riau.shp")
grd <- st_make_grid(polygons, n = c(100, 100))
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
index <- which(lengths(st_intersects(grd, polygons)) > 0)
riau.grid <- grd[index]

grid_df <- spbabel::sptable(riau.grid)
coor.grid_pred <- grid_df[, 2:3]

coor_pred <- matrix(c(koor$lon, koor$lat), byrow = FALSE, ncol = 2)

df_coef <- data.frame(fit1$b_vc$altitude, fit1$b_vc$vegetasi,
                      fit1$b_vc$ekuator2, fit1$b_vc$dummy, koor)
colnames(df_coef) <- c("alt", "veg", "ekt", "dum", "lat", "lon")
```

```{r fungsi-peta}
skala  <- list("SpatialPolygonsRescale", layout.scale.bar(), scale = 25000,
               fill = c("transparent", "black"), offset = c(41000, 4100000))
teks0  <- list("sp.text", c(41000, 4104000), "0")
teks25 <- list("sp.text", c(66000, 4104000), "25 km")
panah  <- list("SpatialPolygonsRescale", layout.north.arrow(),
               offset = c(90000, 4150000), scale = 5000)

# Interpolasi thin-plate spline ke grid Riau lalu dipetakan
peta_tps <- function(koordinat, nilai, judul, palet = "Roma", balik = TRUE, skala_warna = NULL) {
  surf <- Tps(koordinat, nilai)
  pred <- predict.Krig(surf, coor.grid_pred)
  coords <- SpatialPixels(SpatialPoints(coor.grid_pred))
  dffix <- SpatialPixelsDataFrame(coords, data.frame(coor.grid_pred, pred))

  args <- list(dffix[, 3],
               col.regions = hcl.colors(256, palet, rev = balik),
               pch = 20, axes = TRUE, main = judul,
               sp.layout = list(skala, teks0, teks25, panah),
               scales = list(draw = TRUE))
  if (!is.null(skala_warna)) args$colorkey <- list(at = skala_warna)
  do.call(spplot, args)
}
```

```{r peta-koefisien, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
peta_tps(coor_pred, df_coef$alt, "Altitude Coefficient")
peta_tps(coor_pred, df_coef$veg, "Vegetation Coefficient")
peta_tps(coor_pred, df_coef$ekt, "Equator Coefficient")
peta_tps(coor_pred, df_coef$dum, "Dummy Coefficient")
```

# Curah Hujan Aktual dan Dugaan 2019

```{r data-aktual-dugaan}
dir.create("output", showWarnings = FALSE)

bulan <- c("jan", "feb", "mar", "apr", "mei", "jun",
           "jul", "agu", "sep", "okt", "nov", "des")

p_ch <- as.data.frame(matrix(fit1$pred[1537:1920, 1], nrow = 32))
a_ch <- as.data.frame(matrix(Y[1537:1920], nrow = 32))
colnames(p_ch) <- paste0("p_", bulan, "19")
colnames(a_ch) <- paste0("a_", bulan, "19")

write_xlsx(p_ch, "output/p_ch.xlsx")
write_xlsx(a_ch, "output/a_ch.xlsx")
```

```{r peta-september-desember, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
coor_pred32 <- coor_pred[1:32, ]
nama_bulan <- c(sep = "September", okt = "October", nov = "November", des = "December")

for (b in names(nama_bulan)) {
  print(peta_tps(coor_pred32, a_ch[[paste0("a_", b, "19")]],
                 paste("Actual Rainfall", nama_bulan[b], "2019"),
                 palet = "Viridis", skala_warna = seq(0, 400, 50)))
  print(peta_tps(coor_pred32, p_ch[[paste0("p_", b, "19")]],
                 paste("Predicted Rainfall", nama_bulan[b], "2019"),
                 palet = "Viridis", skala_warna = seq(0, 400, 50)))
}
```
